pages.text: $(bold)What To Do First$(/bold)$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Select your Race and Class.$(/bold) These are the most impactful decisions you'll make early. See the Classes & Races chapter.$(li)$(bold)Open FTB Quests.$(/bold) The Welcome chapter gives you 3 skill points for free — just for going through it.$(li)$(bold)Find food.$(/bold) Hunger Overhaul makes food drain faster. Diverse food gives you max HP bonuses via Spice of Life.

$(li)$(bold)Avoid enchanting table anxiety.$(/bold) $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing) completely reworks enchanting. Your bookshelf setup determines what enchants are available — more and better bookshelves unlock better enchants. No $(t1)Tier 1$(end) rush needed.$(li)$(bold)Don't expect diamonds in chests.$(/bold) They've been removed from all Overworld structure loot. Diamonds are a $(t2)Tier 2$(end) material — you'll earn them, not find them.$(li)$(bold)Explore structures.$(/bold) $(t1)Tier 1$(end) token fragments drop from Overworld dungeon chests. Collect 5 for a full token.

$(bold)What To Ignore For Now$(/bold)$(br2)$(li)The Nether — it's $(t3)Tier 3$(end). The portal won't activate until you're ready.$(li)The End — it's $(t4)Tier 4$(end).$(li)Twilight Forest — it's $(t2)Tier 2$(end) content. You can enter, but mobs will hurt.$(li)Refined Storage — it's $(t3)Tier 3$(end).$(li)Mekanism — it's $(t3)Tier 3$(end)–$(t4)4$(end).$(br2)This doesn't mean you can't look. It means the pack is balanced around those tiers.

$(bold)Waystones$(/bold)$(br2)Waystones generate naturally in all dimensions. They're your free fast-travel network. Activating a waystone registers it permanently — teleporting between them costs nothing.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting a waystone$(/bold) is intentionally expensive at all tiers, requiring rare boss drop materials. Natural generation handles your travel needs. Crafting is for establishing outposts far from natural spawns.
